race.comment: SICCIUS (2) started favourite and showed a nice turn of foot to score over 1800m at Port Macquarie last start. Raced once over this trip and failed but it was on a heavy track at the end of a prep. Lightly raced four-year-old who looks well placed here at the third run back from a spell. QUIRKY PRINCESS (6) continues to race well deep into her prep. Battled on fairly to clock in third of four here at this distance last Wednesday. Carries 2kgs less today which brings her under notice. DIPIERDOMENICO (4) worked home well without threatening over 1900m at Armidale recently. Best form comes around this trip so keep him in mind. Greybeard NATURE BOY (7) is usually thereabouts in these sorts of races - a must for trifecta and first four players. The only other runner is NOT SO CASUAL (8) who has been ordinary this time in work but can improve third-up.
